MAIYA AES / CRT - NEOSD CONVERSION TEST
======================================

Official-tool file: Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES_Official.neo
Diagnostic file: Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES_CRT.neo

The diagnostic is the existing AES startup-fixed cartridge with optional
region padding. Game code, graphics, palettes and display timing are
unchanged. No system BIOS is bundled. Use your console's installed BIOS.

The earlier images stored V1 at its raw length, 0x79AB00. The community
converter neosdconv pads P/S/M/V to 64 KiB and C to 256 KiB. The diagnostic stores V1 as
0x7A0000 bytes, appending 0x5500 bytes of FF and updating the header.
Consequently, C starts at file offset 0x861000 instead of 0x85BB00.
C1 and C2 are byte-interleaved, C1 first. Both deinterleave exactly to the
source ROMs; their byte order did not need changing.

The diagnostic matches neosdconv 1.0.2 byte-for-byte:
https://github.com/city41/neosdconv/blob/master/src/buildNeoFile.ts

OFFICIAL CONVERTER RESULT
-------------------------
Terraonion NeoBuilder v1.06 produced Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES_Official.neo.
Its entire output is identical to Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES.neo. It preserves
the raw V1 length and the original C1/C2 byte interleave. Therefore padding
is not a confirmed format defect, and the official conversion does not
resolve the reported corruption by itself. The padded image is an A/B test.

Tool archive (retailer support mirror):
https://stoneagegamer.com/content/flash/neosd/NeoBuilderUI_1.06.zip
Run from the extracted tool directory with its DLLs and order.txt present:
NeoBuilder.exe -n "Maiya: Super Nature Girl" -m "Eagle Software" -y 2026 -g 5 -s 0 -o OUTPUT_DIR AES_ROM_ZIP
The input ZIP contains only the six AES ROMs named 780-p1.bin, 780-s1.bin,
780-m1.bin, 780-v1.bin, 780-c1.bin and 780-c2.bin. A missing-screenshot
notice is expected for this homebrew. No tool binaries are bundled here.

Verification: two packing regression tests passed; all bytes of the padded
image match neosdconv 1.0.2. The unchanged AES cartridge reaches character
selection in MAME 0.289 with the original Japanese AES BIOS. This does not
test NeoSD Pro flash loading or analog CRT output.

Hardware report: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UE-T6EG9ExA
The video preview frames show readable HUD text and scrambled sprite art.
That suggests a graphics-data problem rather than loss of CRT sync, but
does not prove the cause. Neither the conversion nor a sync problem has
been established as the cause. Retest on the NeoSD Pro shown in the video.

TEST
----
1. Copy both new files to the SD card, keeping the older files for comparison.
2. Select and fully flash each new file into a NeoSD slot. Do not launch a
   slot that still contains the earlier image.
3. Use AES/Console mode and the same Japanese BIOS, CRT and cable as before.
4. Check the character portraits, stage background, heroine and sound.
5. Report which image was flashed, BIOS version, NeoSD firmware, and whether
   corruption persists. A short recording of the same stage is useful.

This is a conversion-only hardware test, not a confirmed fix for every CRT
or BIOS. Existing .neo release files are preserved unchanged.

REBUILD
-------
python3 tools/pack_neosd.py --rom-dir roms/maiya --game-id 780 --output dist/release/Maiya-WIP-NeoSD_AES_CRT.neo --name "Maiya: Super Nature Girl"

The ROM directory must contain the AES build when running this command.
